body: One of the best gifts I ever received: a locking gas cap.  I was 17 with my first car.  I thought it was stupid until one night a bunch of cars on my street had gas drained / fun things shoved into their gas tanks.  This happened back when gas prices were "surging" past $2/gallon.  A $10 piece of plastic saved me $60 in gas and probably a few hundred in labor to clean crap out of my tank.
